title: Hanns Seidel Foundation: PhD scholarships
summary: The Hanns Seidel Foundation provides PhD scholarships for international doctoral candidates across all disciplines completing promising theses at a higher education institution in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Doctoral projects and research stays for international doctoral candidates.

subject_areas.notes: Applicants from all disciplines are welcome to apply.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised higher education institution or research institute in Germany.

nationality.notes: International candidates; specific eligibility depends on selecting country from the dropdown/list.

residence.notes: Completing promising doctoral theses at a higher education institution in Germany.

mandatory.text: admission to post-graduate studies at a state or state-recognised higher education institution or research institute in Germany
voluntary engagement (e.g. in politics, churches, social organisations, sport or music)
support for the objectives of the Hanns Seidel Foundation

funding.description: 1,650 EUR per month plus a research cost allowance of 100 EUR and family- and child allowances, if necessary. Non-material support in the form of, e.g., seminars, events and networking meetings.
funding.duration: Initially granted for 2 years. Under extraordinary circumstances the scholarship may be extended for 12 months.

application_rounds.notes: 15 January and 15 July of each year

recurring_deadline_notes: 15 January and 15 July of each year

steps.text: Application forms and further information on the application procedure can be found at the official application link.

sources.title: Hanns Seidel Foundation: PhD scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Provides scholarship funding for international doctoral candidates conducting research towards their PhD at a higher education institution in Germany.
